definitionZh: :目标-当前 CSS 伪类选择活动卷轴标记——当前滚动的卷轴标记. 此选择器可用于对滚动标记组内的主动导航位置进行样式化.
sourceDefinition: The :target-current CSS pseudo-class selects the active scroll marker — the scroll marker of a scroll-marker-group that is currently scrolled to. This selector can be used to style the active navigation position within a scroll marker group.
